purpose: Keep the online ppomppu drafts as the content source of truth, make loading them survive the flakes that cost a run each, and mirror them one way into the workspace so the workspace stops drifting.
design_intent: The operator edits drafts online; the workspace copies are outdated (research/01, F-05). So the fix is not a new content source but a sturdier read of the existing one. Pre-submit steps are idempotent and can be retried within a run; submit is not and never is. Errors are classified once, and the scheduler acts on the class instead of treating every failure as the same backoff.
prerequisite: PR-001 deployed, and DP-001 has seven days of data.

model_execution_guidance.recommended_model: Any capable model; Opus-class for DP-003
model_execution_guidance.note: DP-002 must never re-run submit-post. Assert that in a test before writing the retry.

work_items.title: Measure the draft-row fix in production
work_items.action: After PR-001, count draft-row locator timeouts and selector misses over seven days against the baseline of 10 and 3 per 14 days. If the row timeout is gone, close the row part of DP-002.

work_items.title: In-run retry for idempotent pre-submit steps
work_items.action: When open-saved-drafts, confirm-load-draft-modal or the draft-row click fails, re-navigate to the write page and retry the non-submit half once, with a publisher.step.retried log line. A second failure fails the run as today. submit-post is excluded by construction.

work_items.title: Error taxonomy drives the scheduler
work_items.action: Map every PUBLISHER_* code and playbook failure to transient | terminal | platform. terminal (session lost, write permission denied) feeds SL-002's park; platform (maintenance, WAF 403) feeds existing block deadlines; transient keeps the error ladder. Unknown errors are transient. One table, unit tested.

work_items.title: One-way draft mirror into the workspace
work_items.action: Two halves, because the container has no git checkout (templates/ is not in the image). In the container: on each successful draft load, capture title, body HTML and a hash of the loaded draft into ARTIFACTS_DIR/draft-mirror/ (latest per draft slot only; durable, retention row in OPERATIONS.md), log draft.changed when the hash differs from the last capture, and serve the latest capture at GET /api/drafts/mirror. In the workspace: scripts/sync-drafts.ts fetches that endpoint and writes templates/ppompu-ad-design-system/online-drafts/<slot>.html plus <slot>.meta.json (title, hash, capturedAt), so draft history is reviewable in git (Q-03). It never edits ad-data.yaml or other hand-maintained files; reconciling those stays a human step. Sync is one way: online to workspace.

work_items.title: Selector drift early warning
work_items.action: Log which candidate index matched per step. Warn when a step matches only on a fallback candidate for three consecutive runs, so a ppomppu DOM change is visible before the last candidate stops matching.

acceptance_criteria: Over seven days, no run fails on a single transient pre-submit step failure.
No test or code path can invoke submit-post twice in one run.
Every failure carries a class, and the scheduler's next attempt reason follows from it.
The workspace draft copy matches the latest online draft hash after a successful publish.
out_of_scope: Composing posts from workspace templates (rejected in research/01 while online drafts are the source of truth).
Writing to ppomppu drafts from the workspace.

gate_criteria: npm run lint passes with 0 errors
npm run test:unit and the playbook-runner integration test pass
